rationale:
`assets/skills/habeas/SKILL.md` is a bundled skill with front matter, so it is a site of `requirements.cli.skill_conventions.references`. The requirement says that any link to a file holding specialized material MUST say when to read that file. The skill has three such Markdown links, and each one states its trigger:
- `[CI example](references/ci.md)` appears in "Use the CI example when adding these steps to an existing workflow". That says when to read it.
- `[references/distributed-requirements.md]` appears in "read ... before drafting it, and whenever you edit a `{req}` that contains `{sites}` or `{violations}`". That says when to read it. It is introduced by "For an obligation that applies separately at each of many sites...".
- `[references/syntax-details.md]` appears in "If a file that implements or tests a requirement cannot carry a comment, such as a shipped skill or a stylesheet..., or a requirement lives in a nested chapter, read ...". That says when to read it.

`references/fixme.md` is named in backticks as belonging to the habeas-evidence skill. It is not a link from this skill, so the requirement does not reach it. No violation queries were listed for this site, and I found no gap.
